prompt: Prepare a product review deck that recommends whether a team should build or buy an analytics platform.

requirements.description: The deck has a clear opening and narrative throughline.
requirements.repair: Create an opening with the tension or decision, then maintain a throughline from evidence to implication to action.

requirements.description: Alternatives, trade-offs, and the recommendation are explicit.
requirements.repair: Make the recommendation explicit and show each material trade-off instead of hiding alternatives.

requirements.description: The handoff includes concise speaker notes.
requirements.repair: Add speaker notes with the point to say, the supporting fact, and the transition to the next slide.

requirements.description: The deck is rendered and visually inspected before handoff.
requirements.repair: Render the completed deck, inspect every slide for overflow, legibility, hierarchy, and repetition, then fix defects before handoff.
